orders_shipping_selection_valid.name: orders_shipping_selection_valid
orders_shipping_selection_valid.value: ("orders"."delivery_method" = 'pickup' AND "orders"."shipping_quote_id" IS NULL AND "orders"."shipping_total_incl_gst_cents" = 0) OR ("orders"."delivery_method" = 'post' AND "orders"."shipping_quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."shipping_total_incl_gst_cents" > 0)

checkout_uploads_claim_consistent.name: checkout_uploads_claim_consistent
checkout_uploads_claim_consistent.value: ("checkout_uploads"."claimed_by_order_item_id" IS NULL AND "checkout_uploads"."claimed_at" IS NULL) OR ("checkout_uploads"."claimed_by_order_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "checkout_uploads"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL)
